subject: Monaco
note: Cited to one pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary): Monaco. The lead gives 38,423 people in 2.08 km2; the infobox gives 38,857 (2025 census), 2.084 km2 and a density of 18,446 per km2, which does not equal 38,857 / 2.084 (about 18,646). To avoid the page contradicting itself the script uses only the lead's pair (38,423 and 2.08 km2) and says 'about 18,000 per square kilometre', a figure computed from that pair (38,423 / 2.08 = about 18,470). The page's claim that Monaco is the second-smallest and most densely populated country is attributed to the page. No comparison with another country's density is made. Natural Earth draws Monaco very coarsely and the fine coast is drawn from GSHHG, so the map uses an outline and a marker at the page's infobox coordinate, never a fill. The map shows today's coast, including the 6-hectare Le Portier land reclaimed from the sea and opened in December 2024; no earlier outline is drawn.

claims.text: With a population of 38,423 living in an area of 2.08 km2, Monaco is the second smallest sovereign state in the world, after Vatican City, as well as the most densely populated.
Monaco covers an area of 2.08 km2.

claims.note: The infobox gives 38,857 (2025 census); the lead's figure is used because it is in the same sentence as the area.

claims.text: Monaco has about 18,000 people per square kilometre (38,423 / 2.08 = about 18,470, computed from the page's two figures).
claims.note: Computed; the infobox density of 18,446 is not used because it does not match the infobox's own population and area.

claims.text: It has the world's shortest national coastline of any non-landlocked nation, at 3.83 km.
Fewer than 10,000 of its residents are Monégasque nationals.
Monaco is bordered by France's Alpes-Maritimes department on three sides, with one side bordering the Mediterranean Sea; its centre is about 16 km from Italy and only 13 km northeast of Nice.
A new 6-hectare neighbourhood, Le Portier, has been built by land reclaimed from the sea and was opened in December 2024; it is attached to the ward of Larvotto.
